newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-KAFELNIKOV BEATS BECKER IN GERMAN GRASSCOURT EVENT.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-KAFELNIKOV BEATS BECKER IN GERMAN GRASSCOURT EVENT.

text.p: Top-seeded Yevgeny Kafelnikov easily defeated former Wimbledon champion Boris Becker in the semifinals of the $875,000 Halle grasscourt tournament on Saturday.

Kafelnikov, who ousted Germany's Michael Stich in the quarter-finals on Friday, beat the fourth-seeded Becker 6-3 6-4 in a 75-minute match and will now meet the winner of the second semifinal between Paul Haarhuis and Petr Korda.
Becker was hampered by a weak serve and fell 5-0 behind after just 18 minutes.
The German fought off two set points and held his serve for 5-1 before eventually falling 6-3.
In the second set Becker was annoyed at several close calls that went in favour of the 23-year-old Russian and called an ATP supervisor to the court to complain about the decisions.
It was the first match between the two men on a grass court. In five previous meetings, Becker had won four times.
